plan.design_status: Committed locally before fresh test generation or scoring; motivated by previously inspected rules/sequence tradeoffs.

fusion.scale: Each component's unlabelled validation 98th percentile; fail explicitly if nonpositive.
fusion.threshold: 98th percentile of combined validation scores, strict greater-than
fusion.budget: Apply floor(0.02 * batch_sessions) once to combined threshold candidates; deduplicate by correlated session before ranking. No per-component alert quotas or union of separately budgeted alerts.

plan.mixture: Use every session from each independent generator stream; no label-based sampling, filtering or balancing. Prefix session/event IDs by neutral stream index to avoid collisions. Prefixes are excluded from scoring features. Original generator is unchanged.
plan.primary: Combined calibrated/capped recall and workload versus standalone rules and sequence on fresh_joint, including reader sequence misses.
secondary: alerts gained/lost versus each standalone detector
signal dominance in the shared queue
plan.promotion_policy: Report every predeclared batch and comparator. Do not tune fusion, seed, threshold or population weights after inspecting test results; keep the general reference unchanged.
limitations: Fresh instances of already inspected synthetic families; not blind family validation.
Maximum fusion can favor one component's extreme tail and displace useful alerts from the other.
A shared global cap and global calibration provide no reader-specific recall guarantee.
Validation is reused for unsupervised score scaling and threshold calibration; this is not an independent false-positive-rate guarantee.
Actor-cluster bootstrap intervals condition on fitted models and fixed alert decisions and omit training/calibration and reranking uncertainty.
No automatic promotion, malicious-activity probability, or production efficacy claim.
